issues.claim: Lady K Jewels Boutique, 755 Route 18 #503C (Brunswick Square), listed as an active jewelry boutique
issues.problem: The only trace I could find is a directory page that explicitly marks the location closed; the mall's current tenant list does not include it. Listed as active on 'one directory only' evidence.
issues.fix: Remove, or re-verify with a phone call / mall tenant list before any outreach.

issues.problem: Two problems: (a) the address is wrong - the Patch ribbon-cutting article places it inside Brunswick Square Mall (755 Route 18), not 232 Route 18; (b) the directory that carries the mall listing now reports the location closed. It is also a 4-mall group (Brunswick Square, Garden State Plaza, Paramus Park, Palisades Center), not a single-shop independent.
issues.fix: Drop the entry. If the team wants it, it needs current in-store confirmation and a chain/franchise ruling.

issues.claim: Greenfield Jewelers, 418 State Route 18, 'one directory only'
issues.problem: No current evidence exists. The only substantive hit is a 2004 newspaper ad (418 Route 18 North, phone 732-651-7979). greenfieldjewelers.com, the obvious domain, belongs to an unrelated Pittsburgh store, so the entry currently has no verifiable active status.
issues.fix: Drop, or verify by phone (732-651-7979) and correct the phone field if it is kept.

issues.claim: Hope & Dawn Boutique, 253 Route 18, active women's boutique
issues.problem: The cited Patch feature is from the store's 2010 opening (a 2012 reprint); nothing I found shows it operating now, and one directory snippet reads 'closing soon'. The 'active_evidence: one directory only' is really one stale news article plus a directory.
issues.fix: Verify by phone (732-390-0444) before the team spends time, or move to an unverified/stale bucket.

issues.claim: Lavon Art Gallery, address Unknown, phone 732-257-8981
issues.problem: Only a directory stub and a 1991 newspaper listing (1020 Route 18, 'Movie City 5 Mall') - a mall that no longer exists. No current address, website or activity signal.
issues.fix: Remove unless someone can confirm it still exists.

issues.claim: Monmouth Cards is 'a small NJ-based card-shop group (a handful of stores), not a national franchise'
issues.problem: Contradicted by the business's own store locator: 10 open stores across NJ, CT and MA, plus 2 more listed as coming in fall 2026. That is a multi-state chain, which the mapper's own rules exclude; the stated justification for keeping it does not hold.
issues.fix: Apply the chain rule consistently - exclude - or record an explicit, written exception.

issues.claim: Party Fair, 300 Route 18, kept as 'borderline' regional chain
issues.problem: Party Fair is a multi-store NJ chain (its own site lists separate store phone lines for East Windsor and Hamilton/Mercerville). Under the stated 'no chains' rule it is an excluded type, not a borderline keep.
issues.fix: Exclude, or document a single explicit exception for small regional chains and apply it to every such entry.

issues.claim: Dade Paper Tri-State, 120 Tices Ln, wholesale paper/packaging
issues.problem: Branch of a large multi-state distributor, not a local independent; the list itself calls it 'borderline'.

issues.claim: Aldersgate Outreach Community Center Thrift Store, 568 Ryders Lane
issues.problem: The cited page is the church's own site and carries the congregation's Sunday worship information; the thrift store is a church-run ministry, so the 'worship' exclusion is arguable.
issues.fix: Keep only because it is a public retail storefront; state that exception explicitly so other zones apply the same test.

issues.claim: Brunswick Memorial Home (454 Cranbury Rd) and Mount Sinai Memorial Chapels (454 Cranbury Rd) as two separate funeral homes
issues.problem: Both entries survive on their own sources, but they share one address and are commonly the same funeral chapel campus; listing them twice inflates the count and doubles outreach.
issues.fix: Confirm whether they are one operation and merge or drop one.

issues.claim: Diamond K Dance Studio, address Unknown, 'unverified'
issues.problem: Sources disagree: one lists 3 Lexington Ave, East Brunswick with phone 732-353-6435, another (BroadwayWorld) places it in South Brunswick. 3 Lexington Ave is also the listed address of Absolute Dance Center.
issues.fix: Verify the entity and address, or drop; do not send the team to a possibly duplicated address.

issues.claim: Palmeras Entertainment, https://www.palmerasentertainment.com/, 'event venue / banquet hall'
issues.problem: The domain did not resolve from this environment (DNS failure on two attempts), so 'own website' evidence could not be confirmed; search results also describe the venue as a bowling/arcade family-entertainment complex rather than a banquet hall.
issues.fix: Confirm the site and the category (and whether it is an entertainment venue, an eligible type) before outreach.

issues.claim: Missing data that sources clearly supply
issues.problem: GMI Designs has a live site (gminj.com); Solution Prep's local number is 732-556-8220; The Bird House has its own site (thebirdhousenj.com) and phone 732-651-7300; Allure Jewelry & Watches is at 755 NJ-18, Brunswick Square; East Brunswick Flower Studio is at 16 Emerson St, 732-707-5804.
issues.fix: Fill these fields - they are exactly the contact details the triage team needs.

issues.claim: About 40 'one/two directory only' entries with no website, no phone and in several cases no street address
issues.problem: Most come from the NJBD bulk directory in industrial side streets (Elkins Rd, Cotters Ln, Joanna Ct, Connerty Ct). None could be corroborated, several look like defunct or trade-only operations, and at least two checked entries from that style of source turned out closed (Lady K, Toy Republic).
issues.fix: Treat the bulk-directory tail as unverified; verify or cut before triage rather than carrying it into outreach.

issues.claim: Coverage of the zone's independent retail and services
issues.problem: Eight eligible in-town independents surfaced in my own searches are absent: Rudy's Florist & Gift Shop, Jersey Pawn, Ferris Farms, Donna Bridals, Daisy Dry Cleaners, Baby & Kids Bedroom Gallery, A. Lammers Furniture, Photography by MuSen.
issues.fix: Add after a quick existence check; the florist, garden-center and furniture categories are the thinnest.
